name: backbone-conductor
description: Coordinate coding work through Git-backed intentions, decisions, tasks, and review evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Track an intent from proposal through reviewed Git integration.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a Git-backed coordination ledger. Members can read assignments, propose intentions and decisions, check changes, and submit pinned commits. Coordinators can prepare work; human reviewers retain approval authority.
defaultPrompt: Show my Backbone task and the decisions that affect it.
Record this change as a draft intent before coding.
Check my task against new decisions before I submit.
